On quotation S00022 (customer 'fwod47-n2 Bench Customer') I added a second order line: clicked "Add a product", selected [E-COM06] Corner Desk Right Sit from the product autocomplete dropdown (an option was clicked, not merely typed), set Quantity to 2.00, and let Odoo auto-fill unit price 147.00.
